Jobs.ac.cn is an online platform that connects job seekers, candidates, universities, research institutions, employers, recruiters and other organisations.

The Services may include job search, job listings, candidate profiles, employer accounts, job applications, job alerts, employer recruitment tools and other related features.

Jobs.ac.cn is a platform provider. Unless expressly stated otherwise, we are not the employer offering a position, the candidate applying for a position, or the party making a hiring decision.

You must be at least 18 years old and legally capable of entering into a binding agreement to use the Services.

If you use the Services on behalf of a company, university, research institution or other organisation, you represent that you have authority to bind that organisation to these Terms.

3. Accounts

Certain features of the Services require an account.

When creating an account, you must provide accurate, current and complete information and keep that information up to date.

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for activities carried out through your account.

You must notify us promptly if you believe your account has been accessed or used without authorisation.

You must not:

  • create an account using false or misleading information;
  • impersonate another person or organisation;
  • create an account for someone else without authorisation;
  • share your account credentials with another person where doing so is not permitted by the Services; or
  • maintain multiple accounts for the purpose of circumventing restrictions or enforcement measures.

4. Candidate Accounts and Profiles

Job seekers may create candidate accounts and, where enabled, candidate profiles containing information about their professional and academic background.

You are responsible for ensuring that information you provide in your profile is accurate and does not unlawfully infringe the rights of another person.

Candidate profile information, account information, authentication information and other information associated with your private account are governed by our Privacy Policy and are not included in “Your Content” as that term is defined in these Terms.

Depending on the features and settings available on Jobs.ac.cn, candidate profiles may be visible to employers or other users.

5. Job Applications

Jobs.ac.cn may support both native applications submitted through the Services and external applications directed to an employer's website, careers page, applicant tracking system or other third-party service.

5.1 Native Applications

For a native application, the application is submitted through Jobs.ac.cn and may include information such as your name, email address, CV, résumé, cover note and other application information.

Native application information may be made available to the employer or organisation responsible for the relevant position.

Application information is private recruitment information and is not “Your Content” for the purposes of these Terms.

5.2 External Applications

For an external application, Jobs.ac.cn may direct you to an employer's website, careers page, applicant tracking system or other external service.

Jobs.ac.cn does not control the external application service and does not receive or control the completed application submitted to that external service. Jobs.ac.cn may record that you clicked an application link for purposes such as analytics and platform operation.

Your use of an external application service is subject to that service's own terms and privacy policy.

6. Employer and Recruiter Accounts

Employers and recruiters may create accounts to post vacancies, manage job listings, receive applications and use other recruitment features made available through the Services.

Where you use the Services on behalf of an organisation, you are responsible for ensuring that you have authority to represent that organisation.

Employers are responsible for all information they provide about themselves, their organisation, their vacancies and their recruitment activities.

7. Job Listings

Employers may submit job listings for publication through the Services.

A job listing may include the position title, description, employer information, location, salary or compensation information, employment type, application instructions, closing date and other recruitment-related information.

Jobs.ac.cn may review, moderate, edit, reject, suspend, remove or modify a job listing where we reasonably consider this necessary to operate the Services, comply with law, protect users, prevent fraud or abuse, or maintain the quality and integrity of the platform.

We do not guarantee that any job listing will be published, remain published for any particular period, receive applications or result in a hire.

8. Job Posting Fees and Payments

Certain employer services may be subject to fees. Applicable prices and payment terms will be displayed before you complete a purchase.

Unless otherwise stated, fees must be paid in the currency and by the payment method shown at checkout.

Taxes, duties or other charges may apply where required by law.

Payments may be processed by third-party payment providers. Your use of a third-party payment service may be subject to that provider's own terms.

Except where required by applicable law or expressly stated otherwise, fees paid for Services are non-refundable once the relevant service has been provided or activated.
